name: 60156 · Lk In The Hls, IL
findings: ZIP 60156 (Lk In The Hls) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60156 (Lk In The Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
